highlights: Advertising revenue grew 51% YoY on an FX-neutral basis (58% in USD), well ahead of the market, with slower growth in Argentina and Mexico.
In Fintech, our users continue to pay and transact more with Mercado Pago, with TPV per user up 34% YoY.
Ecosystemic users, those who both shop and bank with us and are most engaged, grew 33% YoY, faster than any other segment.

Users who shop and bank with us generate 70% more GMV than marketplace-only users, 90% more TPV than fintech-only users, and their average revenue per user is 3-4x that of single-vertical users; those uplifts held in Q3.

In Fintech, our platform is digital from the ground up, so our users can do much more with us for the same cost: the cost to serve an active user is around $1 per month, a figure that has been broadly flat since Q1'25 while transactions, products and revenue per user have all grown strongly.
